character.name: Kane
character.visual_identity: Kane, a weathered 32-year-old lone survivor, short dark disheveled hair, jagged scar across left brow, tactical charcoal-olive jacket with reinforced stitched canvas patches, fingerless leather gloves, rugged military backpack with red climbing carabiner and worn bedroll
character.signature_gear: serrated combat blade, cracked handheld Geiger counter, dented brass lighter
character.physical_condition: Right shoulder bound with weather-stained linen, cautious alert posture
character.mental_state: hyper-vigilant, grim resolve, deeply knowledgeable in wasteland survival

eras.name: Era 1: The Ash Fall
eras.subtitle: The Initial Collapse
eras.description: Global skies choked by volcanic ash and orbital debris. Cities are silent husks, and blind subterranean predators hunt by acoustic vibration.
eras.visual_palette: charcoal gray, toxic orange ember glow, thick volumetric ash fog, decaying brutalist skyscrapers, 35mm film grain, 8k cinematic realism

eras.name: Era 2: The Sunken Grid
eras.subtitle: Subterranean Exodus
eras.description: Surface freezes over. Survivors descend into flooded metro transit catacombs, battling bioluminescent aquatic mutants and ruthless scavenger cults.
eras.visual_palette: deep murky teal, bioluminescent cyan fungi, rusted train cars, dripping industrial pipes, underwater flares

eras.name: Era 3: The Celestial Rupture
eras.subtitle: The Anomaly
eras.description: A shattered alien monolith impacts the continent. Reality fractures with shifting localized gravity, crystalline fauna, and mysterious spatial rifts.
eras.visual_palette: violet starlight, levitating obsidian monoliths, shimmering spatial distortions, electric purple mist

eras.name: Era 4: The Iron Ascendance
eras.subtitle: Rise of the Machines
eras.description: Dormant pre-war autonomous war complexes reboot without human oversight. Autonomous hunter-striders and lethal search-drones scour the wasteland.
eras.visual_palette: cold brushed steel, laser crimson optic sensors, blinding searchlight beams in rain, high-tech ruins

world_state.weather: Dense toxic ash fall, waning daylight
world_state.threat: Subterranean acoustic crawlers active in shadows
